content: Yerusalaame Duulata
Issi issi asati Yuhudappe duge Anxokiya wodhdhidi, «Intte Muse wogaa mala qaxxarettontta aggiko oonikka attanaas dandayekketa» giidi ammanizayta tamaarso doommida.

Hessika Phawuloosanne Barnabaasa gita palamaninne ooshsha giddo gelththides; hessa gishshas Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi hara issi issi ammaniza asatara Yerusalaame kezidi ha yo7oza gishshas cimatanne Hawaareta oychchana mala geetettides.

Hessa gishshas Woosa Keeththaya istta Yerusalaame baana mala kiittiin istti Pinqeranne Samaariyara aadhdhi bishe heen diza Ayzaabeti ammanon simmidayssa yootida; he wode ammanizayti hessa siyidi keehi ufayettida.
Istti Yerusalaame gakkiin Woosa Keeththa asay Hawaaretinne cimati istta mokki ekkida; kiitetti bidaytikka Xoossi isttara gididi ooththidayssa ubbaa isttas yootida.
Farsaaweta bagga asatappe ammanida issi issi asati dendidi, «Ayzaabeti qaxxarettanaassinne Muse wogaa naagana mala isttas yootanaas bessees» gida.
Hawaaretinne cimati he yo7oza giddo lo7eththi xeellanaas shiiqida.

Daro palamappe guye Phexroosi dendi eqqidi, «Ta ishatoo! Guuththa wodeppe kase Xoossi tana intte giddofe dooridi Ayzaabeti ta doonappe mishiraachcho qaala siyidi ammanana mala ooththidayssa intte ereeta.
Asa wozina eriza Xoossi nuus immidayssa mala isttaskka Xillo Ayana immidi istta baas ekkidayssa markkattides.
Istta wozinakka ammanon geeshshidi nu giddoninne istta giddon aykko shaakokka ooththibeenna.
Hessa gishshas nu aawatinne nunikka tookkanaas dandayontta qambara ammanizayta toossanaas intte aazas Xoos paacceetii?
Nu attiday likke isttaththoka Godaa Yesusa aadho kiyateththan gididayssa ammanoos» gides.
Shiiqida asay wurikka co7u giin Barnabaasinne Phawuloosi Xoossi istta baggara Ayzaabeta giddon ooththida gita malaatata gishshas yootishin malalettidi lo7eththi siyida.
Istti yooti wursishin Yaaqoobey dendi eqqidi, «Ta ishatoo! Ta gizayssa siyite;
Xoossi Ayzaabetappe baas gidana dere kasetidi izi wostti xeygi woththidaakko Simooni nuus lo7eththi yootides.
Kase nabetan hizgi xaafettida qaalay hayssara gaaggees.
«Hessa gishshas ha Xoossaako simmida Ayzaabeta nu metoththontta mala hayssi ta baggara taas qasho.
Gido attiin eeqas yarshettidi tunida kath moopite; laymappe haakkite; bawuti hayqqida mehe asho moopite; suuth uyopite giidi nu isttas xaafana bessees.
Muse wogay gidikko beniisofe Sambata Sambata gallas Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan nababettishenne katamay dizason sabbakettishe dees» gides.
Ammaniza Ayzaabetas Hawaaretappe Xaafettida Dabdaabe

He wode Hawaaretinne cimati kumeththa Woosa Keeththa asaara gididi ba giddofe issi issi asata dooridi Phawuloosaranne Barnabaasara gaththi Anxokiya yeddanaas qachchida. Ammaniza asaa giddofe waannatizayta Barsabaasa geetettiza Yuhudanne Sillaase doorida.
Istta kushen immi yeddida dabdaabezi, «Intte ishatappe, Hawaaretappe, cimatappe, Ayzaabetappe ammanida Anxokiyaninne Sooriyan, Kilqiyankka diza ammanizaytas nu sarokay inttena gakko.
«Issi issi asati nuuppe gidontta ba baggara nu achchafe biidi ba haasayan intte wozina yaanne haa qaaththidayssanne inttena bul7akidayssa nu siyidos.
Hessa gishshas guuththa asata dooridi dosettida Barnabaasaranne Phawuloosara intteko yeddanaas nu wurikka qaala gaaggidos.
Istti Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa gishshas ba shemppo aaththi immidayta.
Hessa gishshas nu inttes xaafidayssa istti inttes ba doonara lo7eththi yootana mala Yuhudanne Sillaase intteko yeddidos.
Hayta inttes koshshiza yo7otappe hara deexo tooho nu intte bolla woththontta mala nuussinne Xillo Ayanas lo7o misati beettides.
Hessika eeqas shukettida ashoppe, suuththafe, bawuti hayqqida mehe ashoppenne laymappe intte haakkana malassa; intte hayta misatizaytappe haakkiko inttes lo7o; saron diite» gees.
Kiitettida asati moyzettidi duge Anxokiya wodhdhida; heen ammanizayta wursi shiishshidi ehida dabdaabeza isttas immida.
Dereykka nababidi minththeththiza qaalan ufayettides.
Yuhudaynne Sillaasi nabeta gidida gishshas daro zoridi ammanizayta minththeththida.
Heen guuththa wode gam7idi ammaniza asay moyziin guye bana kiittidaytakko simmida.
Sillaasi qasse heen attanaas koyides.
Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi hara daro asatara gididi Godaa qaalaa tamaarsishenne sabbakishe Anxokiyan gam7ida.
Phawuloosanne Barnabaasa Shaaketeth
Phawuloosi guuththa wode gam7idi Barnabaasa, «Nu kase Godaa qaalaa yootida ubba katamata biidi ammanizayti ay mala dizaakko ane yuuyi beyoos, denda» gides.
Barnabaasikka Marqoosa geetettiza Yohannisi isttara baana mala koyides.
Phawuloosi qasse iza ekki baanaas koyibeenna; gaasoykka kase Marqoosi isttafe shaakettidi Phinfiliya geetettizason guye attidi isttara oosos sinth kezontta aggida gishshassa.
Histtiin daro palamay istta giddon medhettida gishshas ba giddon shaaketti wodhdhida; hessa gishshas Barnabaasi Marqoosa ekkidi markaben gelidi Qophiroose bides.
Phawuloosi qasse Sillaase doorides; ammanizaytikka Godaa aadho kiyateththaas Phawuloosa hadara immidaappe guye izi isttafe shaakettidi bides.
Ammanizayta minththeththishe Sooriyaranne Kilqiyara aadhdhi bides.
